title: Rewriting a Passage Across Registers
grammar: Mastering register shifts between colloquial verbal speech and formal nominal prose
goal: I can read and analyze Frigyes Karinthy's 'Így írtok ti' in B2 Hungarian.
I can shift a passage from everyday spoken Hungarian to formal essayistic prose and back.
I can combine nominalization chains, focus, and participial modifiers in a cohesive B2 text.
